svg.title: Loading the cart
svg.desc: Sequence diagram with 4 participants: Browser (actor), Web shop, Shop API and Orders (database). 7 messages, in order: 1. Browser to Web shop: GET /cart. 2. Web shop to Shop API: Load the cart for this session. 3. Shop API to Orders: SELECT items. 4. Orders to Shop API: rows (reply). 5. Shop API to itself: Price and tax check. 6. Shop API to Web shop: Cart JSON (reply). 7. Web shop to Browser: Page (reply).

polyline.title: 2. Web shop → Shop API: Load the cart for this session
5. Shop API → Shop API: Price and tax check
6. Shop API → Web shop: Cart JSON
